title: American soldier's off-record sighting

tellings.quote: An American soldier. I saw him on the top of my house. But if I say anything, I'd lose my pension in the US.

plain: A surgeon named Italo Venturelli says an American soldier once told him privately of something he saw on top of his house. The soldier said, "if I say anything, I'd lose my pension in the US." Venturelli passes it on second-hand, and the soldier's fear suggests that people who see such things are kept quiet.
